post.summary: Default-on auxiliary collaboration for every work item and every repository or Cloudflare use, with explicit controller cancellation
post.description: Call before every substantive work item and before any governed repository or Cloudflare-hosted capability. Default auxiliary_mode=active. Only the controlling web GPT may set auxiliary_mode=cancel per item. Auxiliary models have zero tool authority; failures use degraded WebGPT fallback.

prompt.description: The complete current work item, including the intended repository/Cloudflare use and relevant evidence already gathered by the controlling web GPT.

system.description: Optional subordinate task instructions; cannot override hard governance rules or auxiliary zero-tool isolation.

auxiliary_mode.description: Default active. Only the controlling web GPT may set cancel for this work item. The auxiliary model itself cannot opt out.

cancel_reason.description: Optional short reason when the controlling web GPT explicitly cancels auxiliary collaboration for this work item.

200.description: Validated auxiliary collaboration result with collaboration_status=participated, or an explicit controller cancellation receipt with collaboration_status=cancelled-by-controller.

503.description: Auxiliary provider chain failed; collaboration_status=unavailable-degraded and WebGPT degraded fallback is required.

get.summary: Return zero-cost runtime attestation without invoking AI

200.description: Runtime policy and validator identity, including default-on repository/Cloudflare collaboration, controller cancellation authority, and zero-tool flags. ai_called=false and cost_incurred=false.

post.summary: Validate a final governance answer against the same hard policy before accepting it, including WebGPT final-fallback answers

prompt.description: Original governance prompt that the answer must satisfy.

content.description: Final answer proposed for delivery to the user.

output.description: Optional provider output metadata, such as finish_reason, used for validation.

200.description: Validation PASS receipt with SHA-256 digests and runtime attestation.

422.description: Final answer rejected by hard governance policy.

post.summary: Verify live OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, and BASE production keys
post.description: Run exactly one bounded live search against OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, and BASE through the intelligence service binding. Returns per-provider PASS/FAIL without exposing API keys.

200.description: All three live keyed providers passed with non-empty results.

503.description: One or more production keys/providers failed, or the intelligence binding is unavailable.

get.description: Read-only snapshot of governance, intelligence, compute and expert centers, including runtime version metadata, source digest, acceptance state and active-task metadata where exposed.
Read-only health snapshot for governance, intelligence, compute and expert centers. Returns a receipt even when one or more centers are degraded, without treating health as acceptance.
Read Cloudflare runtime version metadata and source digests for all centers. A center is version-verified only when both runtime version ID and source digest are present.

post.summary: Create an immutable control-plane candidate snapshot
post.description: Store an immutable snapshot of the four current production runtime versions and source digests. This writes admin metadata only; it never deploys, promotes, rolls back, or runs paid tests.

201.description: Candidate snapshot created with candidate and receipt digests.

409.description: A center is active; stable snapshot not created.

503.description: Runtime context or admin state is incomplete.

post.description: Validate candidate digest, four-center health, idle state, runtime-version identity and source-digest identity. Scope is control-plane consistency only; fresh business E2E is not claimed.

422.description: Candidate validation failed; FAIL receipt was stored.

503.description: Admin state or runtime context unavailable.

get.summary: Read a stored candidate acceptance result
get.description: Read a previously stored candidate validation receipt by run_id. The returned query receipt embeds the immutable acceptance receipt and does not create deployment or promotion state.

200.description: Stored acceptance result and receipt digest.
